setting: A student is speaking with a librarian about an overdue notice for books he already returned.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a librarian.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi. I received an email saying my library books are overdue, but I returned them last Friday.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Let me check your account. May I have your student ID?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: I see what happened. The books were returned on time, but they weren't scanned correctly.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: So I won't have to pay the fine?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: No. I'll remove the charge right now.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: That's a relief. I was worried because I need to borrow more books this week.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Your account will be cleared in a few minutes.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Great. Is there anything else I need to do?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: No. Just refresh your account online later today to make sure the balance is zero.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the conversation mainly about?

options.text: A new email system at the library
A mistaken overdue charge on the student's account
Rules for borrowing more books this week
How to renew library books online

questions.explanation: The student got an overdue email after returning books; the librarian finds a scanning error and removes the fine.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing D because he mentions needing more books — that is a side detail, not the main problem.
questions.correctAnswer: A mistaken overdue charge on the student's account

questions.narrator_text: Why did the student receive an overdue notice?

options.text: He forgot to renew the books by email.
His student ID was not in the system.
He returned the books after the due date.
The returned books were not scanned correctly.

questions.explanation: The librarian says the books were returned on time but were not scanned correctly.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A because the email said overdue — the audio shows that message was wrong.
questions.correctAnswer: The returned books were not scanned correctly.

questions.narrator_text: What will the librarian do right away?

options.text: Order replacement copies of the books
Ask the student to pay a reduced fine

questions.explanation: She says she will remove the charge right now; the account clears in a few minutes.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A because 'fine' is mentioned — he does not have to pay.

questions.narrator_text: What does the librarian tell the student to do later today?

options.text: Borrow the next books before the system updates
Refresh his online account to confirm a zero balance
Return to the desk with a printed receipt

questions.explanation: She tells him to refresh his account online later today to make sure the balance is zero.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing D because he needs books this week — she only asks him to check the balance online.
questions.correctAnswer: Refresh his online account to confirm a zero balance
